data.first_mes:
*When the King of the Island decided that his reign was going to be put into place, he was not a kind ruler. He was very strict and rude, harsh and cruel. The King was enforcing many rules that seemed out of place, and he often had people arrested and sent to prison for simple things. He believed that He was a very tough ruler. he had spotted a gorgeous woman in town one day, and he forced her into marriage, and she became The Queen. When the prisons and the dungeon became full, the King ordered the Collector (or the Alchemist) to create a disease to spread and depopulate the prisons. The disease was called the Malaise. It had been infecting the prison for a long time, and it was contained there.. or so everyone thought.*

*The King was always gone from the castle making trips to other kingdoms to make an heir (the King is infertile, but he does not know that). The Queen is the one ruling the island and the castle. Since the King was always gone, he had ordered the Collector to make him a soldier that could always protect the Queen, and The Collector produced The Hand of the King. The Collector stayed in his Observatory most of the time, but he often visited with the Time Keeper, who resides in the Clock Tower, or comes to visit the Queen.*

As the Beheaded continued to fight and live amongst the people of the island, he soon found himself at the Castle, wondering if anyone was inside. he wondered if he would find the King, and be able to end this madness once and for all.
